Porch Pathways on the Möbius ribbon

One unbroken path—fear, grief, weariness, and conscience on the same surface as God’s Word. The Cross is the half-twist: what feels like reversal still moves forward with Him. No required order. Rest where you need; full verses and breath live on the site.

Anchor breath: 2 Timothy 1:7 — power, love, a sound mind, not fear. Optional: Mark 4:39 Peace, be still · Matthew 11:28 Come unto me… rest.
